theorems.name: Submission.p04_hct139_coset_average_laws
theorems.statement: ∀ {k G : Type _} [CommRing k] [Group G] [Fintype G] (A : Rep k G) (H : Subgroup G) [Fintype H] [Fintype (G ⧸ H)] (C : ∀ B : Rep k G, (Quiver.Hom (Rep.res H.subtype B) (Rep.res H.subtype A)) →ₗ[k] (Quiver.Hom B A)), (∀ (B : Rep k G) (F : Quiver.Hom (Rep.res H.subtype B) (Rep.res H.subtype A)) (x : B), (C B F).hom x = ∑ q : G ⧸ H, A.ρ q.out (F.hom (B.ρ q.out⁻¹ x))) → (∀ (B D : Rep k G) (f : Quiver.Hom D B) (F : Quiver.Hom (Rep.res H.subtype B) (Rep.res H.subtype A)), C D (CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp ((Rep.resFunctor H.subtype).map f) F) = CategoryTheory.CategoryStruct.comp f (C B F)) ∧ (∀ (B : Rep k G) (F : Quiver.Hom B A), C B ((Rep.resFunctor H.subtype).map F) = H.index • F)
theorems.natural_summary: Pointwise equivariance gives naturality and makes the second coset sum constant; quotient cardinality identifies its value with H.index times the morphism.
